business_snapshot: FirePit BBQ Co. is an early-stage Lahore barbecue restaurant built on generous, consistently good charcoal-grilled platters -- competing against a crowded local BBQ scene mostly by not skimping on portion size or flavor.
positioning_note: As an early-stage player, FirePit's fastest path to visibility is riding group/social eating occasions -- match nights, Ramadan iftars, and viral food formats -- rather than trying to out-market established BBQ names on brand alone.

trends.why_people_care: PSL match nights mean groups gathering to watch together, and grilled food is the default order for exactly this kind of social, hands-on eating.
trends.bridge_to_business: This is close to a direct fit rather than a stretch -- BBQ platters are already built for group sharing. The move is to package it explicitly as match-night food with a same-day ordering window, not just have platters available and hope people think of it.

product_ideas.name: Match Night Mixed Grill Platter
product_ideas.description: A scaled-up family platter (tikka, seekh kebab, bihari boti, naan) sized and priced for a group of 4-6 watching together.
product_ideas.design_concept: Single large sharing platter, disposable-but-sturdy packaging built for a coffee table, extra naan included by default
product_ideas.target: Groups hosting or attending PSL watch parties
product_ideas.use_case: Ordered a few hours before a big match for evening group delivery

content_ideas.hook: Match night without a mixed grill platter isn't really match night
content_ideas.angle: Fast reel: platter being plated, delivered, table shot mid-match
content_ideas.caption: Tonight's match needs tonight's platter 🔥🏏 Match Night Mixed Grill, feeds 4-6, order before 5pm for evening delivery. #PSL2026 #LahoreEats #FirePitBBQ

content_ideas.angle: Direct broadcast to past customers with a same-day cutoff time
content_ideas.caption: Big match tonight -- get the Match Night Platter ordered before 5pm for on-time delivery. Reply to book your platter.

trends.why_people_care: Ramadan iftars are the highest-frequency group dining occasion of the year -- families and friend groups eating together every single evening for a month.
trends.bridge_to_business: A direct, high-volume fit. The opportunity isn't just 'we're open for iftar' -- it's a dedicated iftar combo that removes decision-making (fixed platter, fixed price, ready at iftar time) for a customer who's ordering food daily and wants it simple.

product_ideas.name: Iftar Family Combo
product_ideas.description: A fixed-price daily combo (mixed grill platter + naan + a cooling drink) timed for iftar delivery, no ordering decisions required.
product_ideas.design_concept: Same combo every day for consistency and speed of prep, clear iftar-time delivery slot
product_ideas.target: Families ordering iftar delivery throughout Ramadan
product_ideas.use_case: Recurring daily or near-daily order for the month

content_ideas.hook: One less decision to make this Ramadan.
content_ideas.angle: Simple, practical post aimed at parents/household organizers -- reliability over hype
content_ideas.caption: Iftar Family Combo: mixed grill platter, naan, and a cooling drink, delivered right on time -- every day of Ramadan. Same combo, same reliability. Order ahead to reserve your daily slot.

trends.why_people_care: Smash-style burgers (thin, crispy-edged patties smashed hard on the grill) have been a sustained food-content format -- people like watching the sear and the crunch.
trends.bridge_to_business: A stretch, but a fun one -- FirePit already grills, so a limited-time 'Smash Seekh Burger' (a seekh-kebab patty smashed and seared burger-style) is a genuine product, not just a marketing gimmick, and it's inherently video-friendly.

product_ideas.name: Smash Seekh Burger
product_ideas.description: A seekh kebab patty, smashed thin and seared on the grill for a crispy edge, served burger-style in a bun with chutney.
product_ideas.design_concept: Visibly crispy dark-seared edge, classic burger presentation, limited-time only
product_ideas.target: Younger customers who follow food trend content, one-time trial purchase
product_ideas.use_case: Limited-time menu item promoted specifically as a trend tie-in

content_ideas.hook: We smashed a seekh kebab. Don't ask, just watch.
content_ideas.angle: Close-up sizzle/sear shot in the classic smash-burger content format
content_ideas.caption: Smash Seekh Burger -- limited time only. You know the format, now taste it. 🔥 #SmashBurger #LahoreFood #FirePitBBQ

trends.bridge_to_business: No workable connection to a BBQ restaurant. Forcing food branding into political news risks alienating some portion of the audience for no upside.
trends.safety_note: Political topic, no natural tie-in, real downside risk with no offsetting benefit -- skip.

top_opportunities.one_line: Launch the Iftar Family Combo this week -- fixed daily combo, positioned as one less decision during a demanding month.
Push the Match Night Mixed Grill Platter today for tonight's match with a hard same-day ordering cutoff.
Run the Smash Seekh Burger as a limited-time TikTok-first item to catch the trend while it's still peaking.

skip_these: budget session parliament -- no natural bridge to a BBQ restaurant, real downside risk with no upside
